name: What is the process for kitchen cabinet refacing?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for kitchen cabinet refacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our refacing process begins with a consultation and measurement of your kitchen. Next, we help you select your desired cabinet door styles, materials, and finishes. Then, your existing cabinet doors and drawer fronts are removed. New veneer is applied to the exterior of the existing cabinet boxes, and new custom-made doors and drawer fronts are installed, along with new hinges and hardware. This structured approach ensures efficiency and minimizes disruption in your Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The refacing process involves consultation, material selection, applying veneer to existing boxes, and installing new doors and hardware.
